scope: Weather first; real public Petclinic examples where Weather cannot admit the renderer. No synthetic compiler fixtures or private UpdateDeal content.

publication.title: Frozen service/process publication
publication.inputs: docs pages render --root ROOT --snapshot SNAPSHOT --publication PUBLICATION --output EMPTY_DIRECTORY
publication.gate: The immutable snapshot and saved publication must load. Frozen manifests, safe paths, content digests and canonical operations must validate. Full publication rendering rejects endpoint exclusions. Output must be new or empty; no model authoring occurs.
publication.limits: An existing saved narrative can be displayed with STALE, UNVERIFIED or UNASSESSED labels. A missing requested-language translation replaces the affected narrative with a translation gap. Rendering does not grant meaning review or prove runtime behavior.

selection.title: Selected native declaration pages
selection.inputs: docs pages render --root ROOT --snapshot SNAPSHOT --input SELECTIONS_JSON --output EMPTY_DIRECTORY
selection.gate: Supply 1–128 exact selections, with unique nonempty IDs, service, endpointDeclaration and workerDeclaration; wiringDeclaration is optional. Applicable captured evidence, source coordinates and publication policy determine the admitted projection. Output must be new or empty.
selection.limits: Selection does not imply source behavior: declaration-only, compiler CFG and source-call expansion have different capabilities. Unsupported evidence produces a local gap or rejects an incompatible selection; no missing behavior is invented.

answer.title: OperationAnswer business reader
answer.inputs: A retained endpoint/process packet and its structurally valid OperationAnswer; docs work explain input mode or a saved review-run export.
answer.gate: Validate the supported answer schema, exact packet binding, cited evidence labels, semantic IDs and references. Plain input rendering may remain DRAFT / UNREVIEWED / NOT_PUBLISHED. Review-run export additionally requires one durable approved unpublished answer bound to that exact work, checkpoint and snapshot.
answer.limits: A locally rendered reader, even with model approval, is not automatically a published service narrative. Optional rich blocks depend on their answer/packet fields and supported schema.

dsl.title: Explicit Java flow DSL projection
dsl.inputs: An explicit codeclew-flow-dsl-profile/1.0 plus retained real Java methods; builder-chain or operation-queue family.
dsl.gate: Validate exact method/file/owner/scope bindings and the selected DSL family. The extractor must recognize the bounded Java AST construction; the publisher writes only new files and refuses collisions.
dsl.limits: AST method references and declared operation queues are static declarations. They do not prove dispatch, execution, completion or deployed activation.

unsupported.title: No supported rendering route in the catalogue source
unsupported.inputs: No supported input selector for this design in source 31a5598.
unsupported.gate: Not renderable through the supported profiles in this catalogue revision.
unsupported.limits: A deferred prototype or similar-looking reader is not evidence that this exact presentation is supported.

state.symbol: state and transition artifacts in scenario rendering

items.title: Documentation overview
items.description: Services and saved scenarios across the real Weather repository.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A valid frozen publication containing its retained overview payload.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The publication renderer copies the saved overview and links its selected service/scenario readers.
renderConditions.otherwise: Absent service/scenario content is not synthesized into new prose.

items.title: Searchable catalogue
items.description: Cross-service metadata catalogue and filters.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A valid publication and its retained subject/operation metadata.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Full pages rendering generates the cross-subject searchable catalogue.
renderConditions.otherwise: An empty selection gives an inventory without populated business examples.

items.title: Service reader
items.description: Dashboard service sections, operations, contracts and source.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A service subject in the frozen publication; selected snapshot service facts.
renderConditions.renderWhen: A service reader is emitted with its canonical sections and source inventory. Authored summaries populate their matching sections.
renderConditions.otherwise: The reader can open with explicit section/operation gaps; missing prose does not prevent the shell.

items.title: HTTP operation reader
items.description: Canonical POST /api/places with behavior and Contract tabs.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A retained entrypoint or declared OpenAPI operation in a service reader.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The operation is selected from navigation/inventory; a uniquely mapped contract routes to its canonical source entrypoint.
renderConditions.otherwise: An entry without narrative shows an authoring gap. An unmapped OpenAPI operation remains a contract-only entry.

items.title: Interaction scenario reader
items.description: The saved forecast-updated consumer narrative.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A saved scenario subject and its frozen operations.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The scenario page is emitted; matching authored operations populate behavior and supporting views.
renderConditions.otherwise: Missing operation prose remains a gap; a title or interaction declaration alone is not a behavior narrative.

items.title: Source-bound process reader
items.description: Dashboard-to-Places thread with complete retained method bodies.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A captured process definition; optionally a source-bound thread or reviewed overview.
renderConditions.renderWhen: A PROCESS overview entry renders the declared trigger, scope and participants; available thread, source outline and lifecycle artifacts are added independently.
renderConditions.otherwise: A missing accepted overview falls back to declared summary or a gap. Missing thread does not become an inferred call chain.

items.title: Receiving service fragment
items.description: Places handler within the same saved thread.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: An explicitly retained serviceFragments record derived from the selected thread.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The matching SERVICE_FRAGMENT entry renders that receiving subtree and the methods it uses.
renderConditions.otherwise: No fragment is created from a coincidentally similar handler or destination name.

items.title: Native compiler declaration pages
items.description: Places.Save selected compiler declaration, exact call sites and source outline.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: Exact selected declarations with applicable compiler evidence.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The admitted native projection writes linked overview, endpoint, worker and diagnostic views.
renderConditions.otherwise: Unavailable behavior stays a declaration-only view or a local gap.

items.title: Native syntax declaration pages
items.description: Existing source-syntax consumeMessage variant. Rendered with earlier source 6f52d11; syntax authority only.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: An admitted source-syntax declaration and exact retained source coordinates.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The selected syntax adapter emits a source declaration reader within its supported capabilities.
renderConditions.otherwise: No compiler target resolution, parameter mapping or causal behavior is supplied merely from syntax. The linked historical example uses 6f52d11.
renderConditions.limits: The rule is researched in 31a5598; this particular example retains its earlier renderer provenance.

items.title: Native source appendix
items.description: Exact retained source fragments and reverse documentation-context links.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: Citations and exact retained fragments in a native bundle projection.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The native writer emits sources.html and source anchors for the retained citation inventory.
renderConditions.otherwise: Only captured source appears; unretained files and method bodies are not fetched to fill the appendix.

items.title: Publication history
items.description: Recorded publication history.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A valid frozen publication.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The full renderer generates history.html from the saved publication history.
renderConditions.otherwise: No new review, publication or runtime event is created by displaying history.

items.title: Reader help
items.description: Explanation of the native reader controls and authority labels.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A valid frozen publication and the reader assets.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The full renderer emits the reader help page with its output bundle.
renderConditions.otherwise: Help is static reader guidance, not a populated business-data block.

items.title: Service profile
items.description: Four accepted service summaries in a profile grid.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A service subject. Matching section operations are optional.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The overview calls serviceProfile and always lays out the four responsibility/entity/ingress/egress cards.
renderConditions.otherwise: Missing accepted summaries show per-card gaps; entity declarations and ingress inventory are independent additions.

items.title: Responsibilities card
items.description: Accepted responsibility prose with source and review status.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching section-responsibilities operation with summary in the saved narrative.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The matching summary populates the service card and section reader as responsibility summary.
renderConditions.otherwise: Without the summary the section shows its explicit gap; pending translation replaces narrative text.
renderConditions.limits: Inventory and accepted prose have separate inputs; one does not automatically author the other.

items.title: Entity and storage-shape summary
items.description: Existing prose about shapes; this is not an entity identity or ownership model.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching section-entities operation with summary in the saved narrative.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The matching summary populates the service card and section reader as entity/storage-shape summary prose.
renderConditions.otherwise: Without the summary the section shows its explicit gap; pending translation replaces narrative text.

items.title: Entry-point summary

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching section-ingress operation with summary in the saved narrative.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The matching summary populates the service card and section reader as entry-point summary.
renderConditions.otherwise: Without the summary the section shows its explicit gap; pending translation replaces narrative text.
renderConditions.limits: Inventory and accepted prose have separate inputs; one does not automatically author the other.

items.title: External calls and storage summary
items.description: Accepted source interpretation of external calls and storage.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching section-egress operation with summary in the saved narrative.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The matching summary populates the service card and section reader as external-call/storage summary.
renderConditions.otherwise: Without the summary the section shows its explicit gap; pending translation replaces narrative text.
renderConditions.limits: Inventory and accepted prose have separate inputs; one does not automatically author the other.

items.title: Operation summary and trigger
items.description: Accepted consumer summary and operation heading.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: An entry record for the trigger/heading; a matching operation.summary for authored prose.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The operation shell displays its retained method/path/title. Authored summary appears when the operation exists.
renderConditions.otherwise: Heading and trigger can still display without prose; the summary slot explicitly reports the missing narrative.

items.title: Readable behavior
items.description: Full ordered narrative with Note, If, Otherwise and Message rows; evidence button on each row.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching operation with events.
renderConditions.renderWhen: behaviorPseudocode renders when at least one event is not end; it preserves Note, branch, message and other documented event rows.
renderConditions.otherwise: No non-end events means no Readable behavior block. A missing operation yields a behavior gap.

items.title: Responsive sequence diagram
items.description: Visible messages and alt/else frames. Hidden Notes remain in Readable behavior.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching operation, its participants and event stream; no authored overviewDiagram override.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Without an overview override, at most 64 original events enter the responsive sequence renderer. Notes are hidden, empty frames/arms pruned and participants restricted to visible messages.
renderConditions.otherwise: Over 64 events without an authored overview shows a bounded-overview gap. Hidden notes and original guards remain in Readable behavior/provenance.
renderConditions.limits: An authored overviewDiagram selects the alternative node/edge overview, rather than this sequence rendering.

items.title: Implementation commentary
items.description: Accepted commentary and supporting source links.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: operation.explanation paragraphs, with detail=true for implementation commentary.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Matching detail paragraphs are rendered inside Implementation details and source commentary; remaining narrative paragraphs can share the disclosure when Readable behavior exists.
renderConditions.otherwise: An empty explanation produces no paragraph body. Exact narrative duplicates already displayed as events can be suppressed.
renderConditions.limits: Authored paragraphs retain authorship and context labels; source links do not themselves verify meaning.

items.title: Scope and evidence boundaries
items.description: Retained limits displayed separately from behavior.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching operation with nonempty boundaries.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The behavior view adds Scope and evidence boundaries when boundaries.length is nonzero.
renderConditions.otherwise: No boundaries means this disclosure is omitted; this is not a claim of complete coverage.

items.title: Evidence contexts and freshness
items.description: Selected snapshot, source revisions, retained explanation context and meaning review.
items.action: Open the disclosures in Evidence contexts.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: Reader evidence contexts and optional section/operation state records.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The reader displays selected source context separately from retained narrative/review context; entry selection updates the state banner.
renderConditions.otherwise: Absent review/freshness information stays UNASSESSED/UNVERIFIED or unavailable; it does not become current or approved.

items.title: Source-derived Kafka interface table
items.description: The real topic association and code-level event checks.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching authored interfaceContracts record describing Kafka/event interpretation.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The Contract view renders the retained source-derived interface card and its evidence.
renderConditions.otherwise: A topic name or a code-level consumer alone does not create this authored card; the view reports missing contract documentation.
renderConditions.limits: No assertion of topic subscription, delivery or runtime routing follows from displaying the card.

items.title: HTTP interpretation and OpenAPI tables
items.description: Source-derived interface card, request body, response schemas, constraints, declared access and raw contract.
items.action: Responses and Complete operation contract are expandable.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching authored interfaceContracts card and/or parsed CONTRACT_OPERATION.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The Contract tab renders source interpretation and parsed OpenAPI as distinct sections; current and retained earlier contract contexts are labeled separately.
renderConditions.otherwise: With neither source interpretation nor matching parsed contract the view shows a documentation gap.

items.title: External call details
items.description: Declared target, boundary contract and provenance of the exact POST /places call.
items.action: Expand Contract and Declaration and provenance.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: An operationExternalCalls row bound to the exact operation ID and event ID.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The matching Readable behavior event includes declared destination, addresses, contract and provenance disclosures.
renderConditions.otherwise: No matching row means no details. Multiple declarations or unavailable/ambiguous contracts produce explicit uncertainty instead of an automatic target.

items.title: Process introduction
items.description: Accepted overview, trigger, participants, selected method count and declared scope.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A captured process definition; accepted overview summary and source-bound thread are optional.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The process overview combines its trigger/scope with the retained summary and participants; method counts come from the thread when present.
renderConditions.otherwise: Summary falls back to the declared definition or a gap; a definition does not prove its stated goals occur.

items.title: Declared service connections
items.description: Real saved declarations with transport, source links and unresolved checks.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A SOURCE_BOUND_DECLARATION thread with cross-service step targets and/or explicitly selected interaction declarations.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The connections section appears if at least one such target or selected declaration exists.
renderConditions.otherwise: No matching connections means this section is omitted; transport is not inferred from the call target.

items.title: Boundary contract
items.description: Request, response, failure and guarantee claims bound to the two retained handlers.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A SOURCE_BOUND_DECLARATION thread with boundaryContracts entries.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Each retained boundary contract renders its request/response/failure/guarantee claims and source links.
renderConditions.otherwise: An empty array emits no contract cards; missingEvidence entries are displayed as unresolved.

items.title: Nested process steps
items.description: Forward call, receiving handler and detailed source-bound steps.
items.action: Expand Detailed steps, or follow the receiving entrypoint link.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A thread whose status is SOURCE_BOUND_DECLARATION and whose steps identify retained methods.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The renderer recursively displays thread.steps and children with exact source anchors and explicit target links.
renderConditions.otherwise: Other thread statuses suppress this component. No steps means no populated step list.
renderConditions.limits: Declared reading order and nesting are not a runtime execution trace.

items.title: Guarded process branches
items.description: Real IF_ELSE arms of Places.Save: city is null and Otherwise.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A displayed thread step with branchGroup and its arms.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The step renders its declared IF_ELSE, FIRST_MATCH or INDEPENDENT interpretation, guards and nested arm steps.
renderConditions.otherwise: No branchGroup means no branch panel; guards are not reverse-engineered from prose.

items.title: Declared effect labels
items.description: Source-linked external-call and return labels.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A displayed thread step with nonempty effects, each carrying its declaration/citation.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The step adds selected effect labels when effects.length is nonzero.
renderConditions.otherwise: No declared effects means the effect list is omitted; calls alone do not establish commit or delivery.

items.title: Complete selected methods
items.description: Both method bodies, exact line anchors, revisions and source bindings.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A SOURCE_BOUND_DECLARATION thread containing methods and methodOrder (or method keys).
renderConditions.renderWhen: The whole-thread source disclosure renders complete selected method text, line anchors, revisions and digests in that order.
renderConditions.otherwise: Unselected methods are not expanded; unavailable thread status suppresses this component.

items.title: Thread scope and unresolved boundaries
items.description: Retained limits for the selected wrapper scope.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A SOURCE_BOUND_DECLARATION thread with scope and optional boundaries.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The thread always includes its scope/limits section; nonempty boundaries populate the list.
renderConditions.otherwise: If boundaries are empty it states that none were declared and completeness is not established.

items.title: Imported note and separate assessment
items.description: Historical real Weather replay record, its metadata and the separate accepted assessment. No current runtime rerun is implied.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A captured human/imported note visible through its target association in this reader.
renderConditions.renderWhen: A NOTE entry renders original capture and metadata; a saved assessment is displayed separately when attached.
renderConditions.otherwise: Missing assessment yields an explicit unassessed state. Changed capture/association leaves the retained assessment labeled stale.

items.title: Exact source panel
items.description: Exact retained source, line numbers, Git revision, text and evidence digests.
items.action: Click Source on the full operation page.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A source/evidence action carrying IDs from the appropriate retained source context.
renderConditions.renderWhen: On activation all requested IDs must resolve before the panel displays exact source text, coordinates, revision and digests.
renderConditions.otherwise: Missing/incomplete fragment context shows an explicit unavailable/incomplete message; no unrelated source is substituted.

items.title: Saved process cards
items.description: Existing process titles, declared triggers, freshness and authoring state.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A service reader with savedProcesses; internal candidates additionally require readerOptions.showInternalProcesses=true.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The navigation entry appears for saved processes, or enabled nonempty internal candidates; saved cards show retained authoring/freshness states.
renderConditions.otherwise: No saved process and no enabled candidate means no process-catalog entry. Candidates alone are not accepted business processes.

items.title: Coverage and analysis authority
items.description: Source counts, syntax/compiler provider details, declared interactions and revision vector.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A service reader and its selected evidence metadata.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The Coverage and evidence control opens source counts, retained boundaries, selected interactions and revision vector.
renderConditions.otherwise: Zero counts/empty interactions are displayed explicitly; this shell does not certify complete discovery.

items.title: Source and API inventory table
items.description: Trigger, operation, coverage and exact identity for all 12 retained Dashboard entrypoints.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: The source catalogue plus declared OpenAPI entries without source mapping.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The inventory control opens rows for retained entries and labels each as documented, pending translation, unmapped contract or authoring gap.
renderConditions.otherwise: An empty inventory stays empty; no missing HTTP/message/scheduled/CLI entry is invented.

items.title: Source-derived HTTP interface card
items.description: The accepted interpretation and evidence table, distinct from the parsed OpenAPI fields.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching operation.interfaceContracts source-derived HTTP record.
renderConditions.renderWhen: interfaceContracts renders the authored interpretation/evidence card independently of parsed OpenAPI.
renderConditions.otherwise: A parsed schema alone does not populate this authored card.

items.title: OpenAPI request parameters
items.description: This real POST operation declares no parameters; the renderer displays the empty case explicitly.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A matching parsed OpenAPI contract operation.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Every displayed parsed contract includes Request parameters; declared parameter rows appear when present.
renderConditions.otherwise: An empty parameters array displays No parameters declared; without a parsed contract the section does not exist.

items.title: OpenAPI request body and field constraints
items.description: Real required cityId field, string type and declared enumeration.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A displayed parsed OpenAPI operation with requestBody.content media/schema.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Declared media types render field tables, required flags and constraints; declared examples appear only when supplied.
renderConditions.otherwise: No content shows No body declared. Deep schema recursion falls back to raw schema instead of inventing fields.

items.title: OpenAPI response schemas
items.description: Declared 200, 400, 415, 500 and 503 responses. The preview opens each response.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A displayed parsed OpenAPI operation.responses map.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Each declared response status is an expandable row with its description, body schema and examples.
renderConditions.otherwise: No declared response entries means no populated response rows; no success/failure schema is inferred from handler prose.

items.title: Declared access and servers
items.description: The real contract has null security and server records. This demonstrates the actual empty declaration case.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A displayed parsed OpenAPI contract, with optional security and servers fields.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Declared access and servers displays the retained declarations as JSON, even when null.
renderConditions.otherwise: Null/absent declarations remain null/empty; that is not evidence of public access or a particular deployment URL.

items.title: Complete operation contract
items.description: The retained machine-readable OpenAPI operation, opened as a disclosure.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A displayed parsed OpenAPI contract operation.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The Complete operation contract disclosure contains that retained machine-readable operation.
renderConditions.otherwise: No matching parsed operation means there is no raw-contract disclosure.

items.title: Original imported runtime record
items.description: The exact historical Weather replay record, preserved without converting it to compiler evidence.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A visible captured note with original.text, reason or status.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The NOTE reader displays the original capture in its own preformatted block.
renderConditions.otherwise: Unavailable text is represented by the retained reason/status rather than invented note content.

items.title: Imported note metadata and associations
items.description: Original classification, timestamp and captured input associations.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A visible note with its captured association object.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Original metadata and associations always exposes that note association independently of assessment.
renderConditions.otherwise: Missing/unresolved targets are labeled; metadata is not promoted to compiler evidence.

items.title: Separate agent assessment
items.description: Existing accepted assessment with its own evidence, review and freshness status.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A visible note; populated assessment requires note.assessment.assessment and summary.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Separate agent assessment displays the attached outcome/period/summary and evaluates note/association digest match plus targetChanged.
renderConditions.otherwise: No assessment shows No assessment has been accepted; a mismatch displays stale rather than rewriting the original record.

items.title: Compiler declaration and signature
items.description: The actual C# PlacesController.Save declaration and exact source citation.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: An admitted compiler callable projection with retained declaration citation.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The endpoint/worker view displays the declaration, signature, authority and exact source link.
renderConditions.otherwise: Unresolved/unsupported declaration identity remains a gap or fails selection validation; no signature is guessed.

items.title: Cited C# source outline
items.description: Actual local source structure: calls, city-null guard, BadRequest and Ok returns. A text outline, not a compiler CFG.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A selected callable with source_outline populated by an applicable adapter.
renderConditions.renderWhen: source_outline_panel renders the retained local statement/call outline and source citations.
renderConditions.otherwise: No source_outline means no panel. A C# outline is not a compiler CFG.

items.title: Retained exact call-site list
items.description: Compiler target status, exact spans and source citations for Places.Save calls.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: Retained exact call sites attached to the selected callable.
renderConditions.renderWhen: retained_call_sites_panel displays source spans and retained target resolution status, including unresolved/external cases.
renderConditions.otherwise: No captured call sites means no populated call-site rows; textual similarity cannot resolve a target.

items.title: Expanded source-call bodies
items.description: Five real retained methods, including repository Save, InsertRequest, City and Open.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: expandSourceCalls=true and an admitted bounded source-call graph.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The native source-calls page displays the exact retained callee bodies selected by expansion.
renderConditions.otherwise: Unretained, unsupported or external targets remain gaps; declaration selection by itself does not expand arbitrary callees.

items.title: Examined documentation context
items.description: Documentation-context links retained for the selected method bodies; not runtime impact.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A retained source-call graph with examined documentation-context links on its nodes.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Expanded source bodies include matching retained context links and their stated authority.
renderConditions.otherwise: No retained context links means no populated context list; no runtime impact or dependency traversal is inferred.

items.title: Question and local limits
items.description: Projection authority and unavailable behavior/state/relationship claims.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A selected native page projection and its question, diagnostic and gap records.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The native diagnostic view reports the question, available authority and local limitations.
renderConditions.otherwise: Unsupported behavior/state/handoff claims remain diagnostic gaps even when declaration pages render successfully.

items.title: Native catalogue and source index
items.description: Native source index, selected declaration search and links to all output pages.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: An admitted native bundle projection and its retained page/citation inventory.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The writer generates the native catalogue/search index and source appendix links.
renderConditions.otherwise: Only selected/examined context is indexed; it is not a repository-wide runtime inventory.

items.title: Execution flow · consumeMessage
items.description: Luna Max visual of the actual Dashboard handler. Parsing, validation, rejection and applyEvent remain source interpretation.
items.action: Original native author/reviewer run: ACCEPTED. This retained comparison publication displays STALE / UNASSESSED; it does not reapprove the visual.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: An operation.visuals artifact of kind execution-flow, with purpose, scope, nonempty nodes, valid edges, evidence-bound claims and explicit limitations.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The validated typed artifact is in the retained operation; visualCard calls visualGraph for its nodes/edges describing execution relationships.
renderConditions.otherwise: Absent artifact means no view. Invalid graph shape is rejected before publication; the UI also has a no-nodes fallback.
renderConditions.limits: Graph placement alone does not imply execution order; displayed freshness/review belongs to the containing operation.

items.title: Dependency map · Dashboard consumer
items.description: Typed Luna Max map of the handler, validator, applyEvent and their source-bound dependencies. It does not prove deployed wiring.
items.action: Original native author/reviewer run: ACCEPTED. This retained comparison publication displays STALE / UNASSESSED; it does not reapprove the visual.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: An operation.visuals artifact of kind dependency-map, with purpose, scope, nonempty nodes, valid edges, evidence-bound claims and explicit limitations.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The validated typed artifact is in the retained operation; visualCard calls visualGraph for its nodes/edges describing dependencies.
renderConditions.otherwise: Absent artifact means no view. Invalid graph shape is rejected before publication; the UI also has a no-nodes fallback.
renderConditions.limits: Graph placement alone does not imply execution order; displayed freshness/review belongs to the containing operation.

items.title: Decision table · duplicate and forecast selection
items.description: Luna Max decision table for applyEvent with explicit hit policy, source citations and limitations.
items.action: Original native author/reviewer run: ACCEPTED. This retained comparison publication displays STALE / UNASSESSED; it does not reapprove the visual.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A typed decision-table visual with nonempty rules, FIRST/UNIQUE/UNKNOWN hitPolicy and evidence-bound policyExplanation; no graph fields.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The retained artifact renders conditions/outcomes and hit policy. A parent node link is added only if an explicit valid parent is supplied.
renderConditions.otherwise: Missing artifact means no table; absent/invalid policy, empty rules or invalid parent references fail structural validation.
renderConditions.limits: Row selection and action execution remain separate; this is not an executable or formally verified DMN model.

items.title: Declared state diagram · request_outbox.published
items.description: The real C# publisher reads NOT published, produces the event, updates published=true and commits. These are declared SQL flag states, not observed delivery.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A captured process-state schema for the selected scenario/process.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Scenario rendering creates stateDiagram; the reader shows declared states and transitions.
renderConditions.otherwise: No schema means no state diagram. Without generated SVG the reader retains PlantUML/fallback information; event names do not invent states.
renderConditions.limits: Declared states and source bindings do not prove observed transitions.

items.title: Activity on lifecycle transitions · PublishPending
items.description: The same declared lifecycle selects the actual PublishPending source. Original operation source and state declarations remain available.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A captured process-state schema with transitions whose operation is nonempty and resolves in the selected evidence.
renderConditions.renderWhen: activity_transitions_puml returns an artifact only if at least one resolved operation group remains; the reader then adds Activity on transitions.
renderConditions.otherwise: No resolved operation groups means no activity artifact. SVG failure is separate from source/PlantUML availability.

items.title: Domain identity and relation · Place
items.description: Explicit Place identity and proposed stored-copy relations for event.place and weather_cards. Existing accepted entity prose is copied exactly; authoritative ownership remains unverified.

renderConditions.renderWhen: The entity section filters declarations to the selected service and renders identity, relation and supplied provenance.
renderConditions.otherwise: No matching declaration produces an entity-declaration gap. DTOs, table names and summary prose alone do not qualify.
renderConditions.limits: An agent-proposed stored-copy relation does not establish authoritative ownership.

items.title: Entity dataflow · Place in Dashboard
items.description: Real parsed payload, validation and weather_cards paths. Luna-authored graph with two mechanical identity/title corrections; native structure accepted, meaning UNASSESSED, linked process stale.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A registered entity-dataflow view/module and an operation.dataflow graph bound to its exact definition digest and selected evidence.

items.title: Shared queue wiring and correlation
items.description: Weather uses database outboxes and Kafka, not an in-process BlockingQueue. Public producer/consumer candidates inspected so far do not satisfy the current native proof: single queue operation, constructor-injected fields and one straight-line shared allocation. No populated example is claimed.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: Explicit endpoint, worker and wiring compiler declarations in one scope; supported producer storage/constructor bindings and a local queue allocation.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The proof must bind exactly one endpoint construction and one worker construction to the same local allocation/alias, with qualified queue operations and storage citations.
renderConditions.otherwise: No wiring or incompatible evidence produces LOCAL_GAP; unequal/ambiguous allocations produce SHARED_QUEUE_OBJECT_UNPROVEN. No real admissible demo is currently in this catalogue.
renderConditions.limits: The proof is source-declared shared-object wiring, not enqueue success, scheduling, delivery, runtime correlation or completion.

items.title: Maintained paragraph with declared authorship

renderConditions.requiredInputs: An authoredParagraphs selector naming a frozen publication, operation and exact fragment with declared user authorship.
renderConditions.renderWhen: The fragment must have an exact frozen binding and match the selected endpoint symbol/declaration/evidence context; then it is attached with authorship/context freshness.
renderConditions.otherwise: Missing/ambiguous fragment, absent authorship or incompatible endpoint context rejects attachment. An ordinary generated summary does not qualify.
renderConditions.limits: Declared authorship and exact context do not establish semantic review; protected prose is preserved.

items.title: Java flow DSL · builder-chain and operation-queue
items.description: Weather has no Java flow DSL. Real VoltDB compound-procedure demos use inline newStageList(...).then(...), while this renderer requires a builder bound directly to a declared root variable. Other searched candidates also do not admit a populated projection. Both DSL families remain open; synthetic Codeclew fixtures are excluded.

renderConditions.requiredInputs: A real retained Java DSL declaration plus an explicit profile for builder-chain or operation-queue.
renderConditions.renderWhen: Builder-chain requires a single supported direct root initializer with method-reference arguments and admitted root .then chains. Operation-queue requires the selected queue construction and exact registry/operation bindings.
renderConditions.otherwise: Unsupported/ambiguous AST constructions remain gaps or fail extraction; inline/nested builders cannot be assumed to satisfy the root initializer contract. No real admissible demo is currently linked.
